content.short: Worlds Beyond is a decentralized social metaverse platform where players can build, share, and play in 3D worlds.
content.description: Worlds Beyond is a pioneering decentralized social gaming platform and digital universe, designed to provide users with a transparent and immersive framework for virtual creativity. The platform features an intuitive "no-code" world builder that empowers creators to design, publish, and monetize their own 3D environments and interactive games. Worlds Beyond focuses on interoperability, allowing players to carry their digital assets and customizable avatars across a vast virtual landscape. Utilizing a community-driven model, participants are fairly rewarded for their work.
content.meta: Worlds Beyond offers a decentralized social metaverse and 3D world-building. Discover Worlds Beyond and other Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
